back_translation: "Behold My servant, whom I uphold, My chosen one in whom My soul delights. I have put My Spirit upon him; he will bring forth justice to the nations.
He will not shout or raise his voice, nor make anyone hear his voice in the street.
A bruised reed he will not break, and a dimly burning wick he will not extinguish; he will bring forth justice in faithfulness.
He will not grow dim and will not be bruised until he establishes justice on the earth, and the islands will wait for his law."

Thus says God, the LORD, who created the heavens and stretched them out, who spread out the earth with all that springs from it, who gives breath to the people upon it and spirit to those who walk on it:
"I, the LORD, have called you in righteousness; I will take hold of your hand. I will keep and guard you, and appoint you to be a covenant for the people, a light to the nations,
to open blind eyes, to bring prisoners out of the dungeon, and to lead those who sit in darkness out of the prison house.
I am Yahweh — that is My name! I will not give My glory to another, nor My praise to carved idols.
Behold, the former things have come to pass, and new things I now declare; before they spring forth I let you hear of them."
Sing to the LORD a new song; sing His praise from the ends of the earth — you who go down to the sea and all that is in it, you islands and all who dwell in them.
Let the wilderness and its cities lift up their voices, with the villages where Kedar dwells. Let the people of Sela sing for joy; let them shout from the mountaintops.
Let them give glory to the LORD and declare His praise in the islands.
The LORD will go out like a mighty warrior; He will stir up His zeal like a man of war. He will shout, He will raise the battle cry, and He will prevail over His enemies.
"I have kept silent for a long time; I have stayed quiet and restrained Myself. But now I will cry out like a woman in labor; I will gasp and pant together.
I will lay waste the mountains and hills and dry up all their vegetation. I will turn the rivers into islands and dry up the pools.

I will lead the blind by a way they do not know; I will guide them along paths they have not known. I will turn the darkness before them into light and the rough places into level ground. These things I will do, and I will not forsake them.
But those who trust in carved idols, who say to cast images, 'You are our gods,' will be driven back and utterly put to shame.
"You deaf ones, listen! You blind ones, look and see!
Who is blind like My servant, or deaf like the messenger I send? Who is blind like the one in covenant with Me, blind like the servant of the LORD?
You see many things but do not pay attention; your ears are open, but you hear nothing."
The LORD was pleased, for the sake of His righteousness, to magnify His law and make it glorious.
But this is a people plundered and looted, all of them trapped in pits and hidden away in prisons. They have become prey with no one to rescue them, plunder with no one to say, "Give them back!"
Who among you will give ear to this, will pay attention and listen in the time to come?
Who handed Jacob over to the looter, and Israel to the plunderers? Was it not the LORD, against whom we have sinned? For they would not walk in His ways, and they did not obey His law.
So He poured out on him the heat of His anger and the violence of war. It blazed all around him, yet he did not understand; it consumed him, yet he did not take it to heart.
